_source: Menu transcribed by hand from the restaurant's own printed menu photos supplied by the project owner (2026-10-07). Prices are in INR exactly as printed. Fields the menu does not state are omitted (null price = ask the restaurant, null veg = unknown). Address, opening hours, rating, contact and delivery time were not available and are NOT filled in. Udupi Deluxe: the name, pure-veg status and storefront photo were supplied by the project owner; the menu (names and prices exactly as typed by the owner from the restaurant's menu, duplicates merged) was supplied as text. Address, town, phone, opening hours, rating and delivery info could not be verified and are left empty. Butter Scotch scoop has two different printed prices (100 / 110) so no price is stated. The Royal Olives Restaurant: the menu (names, prices, descriptions and 'Vegetarian' labels exactly as supplied by the project owner, unmarked items are non-veg by name or section) and the storefront photo were supplied by the owner. Address, phone, hours, rating and delivery info could not be verified and are left empty; the town comes from the menu wording ('Bhatkal Special').

restaurants.name: The Royal Olives Restaurant
restaurants.description: Tandoori and North Indian dishes, Chinese starters, seafood, biryani, desserts, juices, milkshakes and mocktails.

menu.name: Tandoori Chicken
menu.description: Our Tandoori Chicken is marinated overnight in yogurt, ginger-garlic & traditional tandoor spices, then grilled for a smoky char. Juicy, mildly spicy and served with mint chutney & salad. Contains dairy; may contain traces of nuts. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Malai Chicken Tikka
menu.description: Crafted the Royal Olives way, our Malai Chicken Tikka features premium chicken marinated in fresh cream, cashew paste, mild spices & a hint of white pepper, then gently char-grilled for a buttery melt-in-mouth finish. Subtle, elegant, luxurious. Served with mint chutney. Contains dairy & nuts. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Chicken Cheese Garlic Kaba
menu.description: Our Chicken Cheese Garlic Kabab is juicy minced chicken blended with creamy cheese, fresh garlic & hand-ground spices, charcoal-grilled to a golden, gooey inside and smoky outside. Rich, melty, irresistibly garlicky. Served with mint dip. Contains dairy & gluten. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Oyster Chicken
menu.description: Our Oyster Chicken is a hot wok-tossed stir-fry of tender chicken glazed in savory oyster sauce with garlic, crunchy veggies & a hint of pepper. Bold, glossy, umami-packed—fair warning: it’s addictive. Served with rice or noodles. Contains soy & gluten. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Thaibu Chicken
menu.description: Our Thaibu Chicken is succulent chicken slow-cooked in a fiery, aromatic coastal masala with curry leaves, roasted spices & a splash of tangy heat that hits all the right cravings. Juicy, bold, dangerously addictive—you’ve been warned. Best with neer dosa or rice. Contains dairy; may contain nuts. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Chicken Manchurian
menu.description: Our Chicken Manchurian features crispy battered chicken wok-tossed in a fiery garlic-soy-chilli sauce with onions & spring greens. Glossy, spicy-sweet and dangerously moreish—perfect with fried rice or noodles. Contains soy, gluten & eggs. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Chicken Lollipop
menu.description: Our Chicken Lollipop is the fastest mover on our menu—crispy-fried, spice-marinated chicken wings tossed in a bold Indo-Chinese glaze with garlic, chilli & spring onions. Hot, crunchy, gone-in-seconds good. Served with tangy dip. Contains soy & gluten. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Dal Tadka
menu.description: Our Dal Tadka is comfort turned crave—slow-simmered yellow lentils finished with a sizzling tempering of ghee, garlic, cumin, red chilli & desi spices poured live on top for that irresistible aroma. Simple, soulful and surprisingly addictive. Best with jeera rice or roti. Contains dairy. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Murgh Lababdar
menu.description: Our Bhatkal Special Murgh Lababdar features juicy chicken simmered in a rich, velvety tomato-cashew gravy with butter, fresh cream & roasted spices—deep, smoky and mildly sweet-spicy, just like Bhatkal loves it. Best with naan or kulcha. Contains dairy & nuts. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Chicken Dum Biryani
menu.description: Our Chicken Dum Biryani is slow-cooked on dum with fragrant basmati rice, tender marinated chicken, fried onions, mint, saffron & house spices. Medium-spicy and sealed for maximum aroma. Served with raita & salan. Contains dairy; may contain nuts. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Mutton Dum Biryani
menu.description: Our Mutton Dum Biryani is slow-cooked on dum with fragrant basmati rice, tender marinated mutton, caramelized onions, mint, saffron & signature spices. Rich, aromatic and medium-spicy. Served with raita & salan. Contains dairy; may contain nuts. Prepared fresh on order.

menu.name: Kenz Elaneer Payasam
menu.description: Our best-selling Kenz Elaneer Payasam is a silky slow-cooked dessert made with fresh tender coconut pulp, coconut milk, milk, jaggery & a touch of ghee-roasted nuts. Light, aromatic and irresistibly refreshing—people order it twice for a reason. Contains dairy & nuts. Prepared fresh.

menu.name: Royal Gadbad
menu.description: Our Royal Gudbud is Bhatkal’s legendary layered dessert—vanilla, strawberry & mango ice cream stacked with fresh fruits, jelly, nuts & silky falooda, finished with a royal drizzle of rose syrup. A colourful crunch-and-cream celebration in a glass. Contains dairy & nuts. Prepared fresh.
